{{Top|leg}}
'''Master of the Spirit''' was an accolade bestowed upon [[Kentra]] who were considered to be a master in the one of the [[Species/Legends|species']] three disciplines; [[Sword, Plow, and Spirit]]. The [[High Priestess (Kentra)|High Priestess]] of the [[Holy Order of the Je'ulajists]] was a Master of the Spirit.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>
